config.purpose: 06: images read as sequences; RNN, LSTM and GRU, attention readout and reading order, same photos and training budget as 04-05
config.size_policy: Same hidden state (128) for every cell, so cells are compared with the same memory. Parameters differ by cell and are far below the Dense of 04; Dense and CNN are reported as references, not as a parameter-matched contrast. Matching about 1 M parameters would make each epoch 5-10 times slower on CPU.

cells.question: Which recurrent cell reads the columns best? Simple RNN, LSTM and GRU with the last state

attention.question: Does attention over all states help the same LSTM? Only the readout changes

rows.question: H6: does the reading order matter? The same LSTM reading rows instead of columns

config.phase_order: cells first; attention and rows only after cells results are saved
config.normalization: same RGB64 per-channel train moments as 04 (shared cache), applied before building the sequence
config.checkpoint: maximum validation macro-F1; first epoch wins ties
config.early_stopping: stop after 5 successive epochs without validation loss decreasing; different from checkpoint selection
config.primary_analysis: all three seeds; paired by seed; no selection of best seed or best cell for illustration
config.test_policy: do not load or evaluate test images in this notebook

cost_feasibility.decision: Measure one real epoch per variant of the phase. Train only if the conservative estimate for three seeds fits the phase budget; otherwise stop for an explicit amendment. Never cap photos automatically.
cost_feasibility.amendment: On 2026-11-26, before any recurrent training, budgets of 5 h (cells, 9 fits), 2 h (attention, 3 fits) and 2 h (rows, 3 fits) were registered after a CPU micro-benchmark of 0.4-1.2 min per training epoch.

scope_limits: one recurrent layer, unidirectional; bidirectional, stacked and CNN+RNN variants are optional extensions
8x8 patches are not run: they change the neighbourhood represented
validation is used for stopping and selection, so these are not final unbiased estimates
attention weights show where the readout looks, not why the class is predicted
evaluation describes the selected garment types after quality controls, not the whole catalogue

normalization.method: population pixel moments after RGB64 Lanczos resize
